capabilities.label: 02 / What we solve
capabilities.title: Your operation is complex. Your technology should make it easier to run.
capabilities.body: We connect ERP, POS, e-commerce, CRM and WhatsApp. We sort out the dependencies and build the integrations, agents and processes your company needs.

integracion.body: Data that reaches its destination. Tools that work together. Fewer manual handoffs between teams.

arquitectura.body: A map of what you have, an order for what comes next, and the team that takes it to production.

method.label: 03 / How we work
method.title: From the first map to the system in production. With the same team.

steps.title: Understand.
steps.body: Applications, data, dependencies and points of failure. First, a reliable view of your operation.

steps.title: Prioritize.
steps.body: What to connect, what to automate and what to build. Decisions based on impact, risk and effort.

steps.title: Build.
steps.body: Integrations, automations and custom systems. Implementation, testing and go-live.

team.label: 04 / Judgment and execution
team.title: Architecture and implementation are part of the same work.
team.body: IA Operators grew out of Luiz Brazão's experience connecting technology and operations. Understanding the problem and building the solution stay under the same technical direction.

closing.label: Your next project
closing.title: Let's make your systems work as one.
